notes.content:

And it runs <great!>

In addition, this new update sets live a bunch of additional content for all users (these were previously available in our 'experimental' branch)!

[h2]TWO new boomerangs[/h2]
[b]The Craftyrang[/b]
Hand-crafted by Shiela's advanced pre-school class from the finest repurposed wood remnants. It has a hair trigger and really packs a wallop.

[b]The Camerarang[/b]
[i]*click* Looking great! *click* You're a (Tasmanian) tiger, baby! Yeah! *click*[/i]
Bush Rescue HQ has prepared a new Rang for TY, perfectly crafted to capture the moment.
Introducing the Camerang!

[i]During Combat[/i]
[list]
[*] Stun those pesky Frills by throwing the Camerang toward them, generating bombarding camera flashes.
[/list]
[i]In Camera Mode[/i]
[list]
[*] Of course, you could use the Camerang for how it's intended... taking photos!
[*] Pause the action to line up the perfect shot - adjusting angle, zoom and much more.
[*] Apply filters such as; Blur, Toon or Pixelate.
[*] Strike a pose by switching to Selfie Mode, presenting multiple pose options for TY.
[/list]

[h2]More Skins![/h2]
Three new TY skins and three new fourbie skins!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28002635/d338e5af0611dd60d52fde00e6149c0ed845f3bb.png[/img]

notes.title: TY2 Update in Open Beta - New content!
notes.content:
Hi all!

Struth! A new TY2 build, chockers with goodies!

[h1]How do you get it?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Quit and relaunch Steam to make sure you get the lastest build data
[*] Right click on the game in your library and select "Properties"
[*] Change to the "Betas" tab
[*] And select "experimental" from the drop down! (no password required)
[/list]

[h1]Why Open Beta?[/h1]
[list]
[*] There are a LOT of changes and we want to make sure that things work well across a variety of different hardware configurations
[*] So we'd love for people to give it a fair shake of the sauce bottle, and let us know any issues in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/411970/discussions/1/]Bug Sub Forum[/url]
[*] Please see the pinned "Sending Krome Studios pub reports" post for details on what we'd like if you hit an issue
[/list]

[h1]So What's Been Added?[/h1]
[h2][b]TWO new boomerangs[/b][/h2]

[h3]The Craftyrang[/h3]
Hand-crafted by Shiela's advanced pre-school class from the finest repurposed wood remnants. It has a hair trigger and really packs a wallop.
[previewyoutube=HKqL_Xgt5cI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The Camerarang[/h3]
[i]*click*[/i] Looking great! [i]*click*[/i] You're a (Tasmanian) tiger, baby! Yeah! [i]*click*[/i]
Bush Rescue HQ has prepared a new Rang for TY, perfectly crafted to capture the moment.
Introducing the Camerang! (cue the video...)
[previewyoutube=fsTQAiD-fw8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Camerang Features[/b]
[i]Combat[/i]
[list]
[*] Stun those pesky Frills by throwing the Camerang toward them, generating bombarding camera flashes.
[/list]
[i]Camera Mode[/i]
[list]
[*] Of course, you could use the Camerang for how it's intended... taking photos!
[*] Pause the action to line up the perfect shot - adjusting angle, zoom and much more.
[*] Apply filters such as; Blur, Toon or Pixelate.
[*] Strike a pose by switching to Selfie Mode, presenting multiple pose options for TY.
[/list]
Once you get your hands on this rang, be sure to share your masterpieces with your friends!

[h2]More Skins![/h2]
[list]
[*] three new TY skins and three new fourbie skins!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28002635/d338e5af0611dd60d52fde00e6149c0ed845f3bb.png[/img]

[h2]Updated Infrarang FX[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've updated the effects on the infrarang, for your visual enjoyment, to be like the upgraded visuals that we added to TY1HD
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these updates and can help us by sending through details on any issues that occur, so we can do the full release early in 2022!

====================
Australian to Understandable English Rosetta Stone
[list]
[*] ripsnorter = something extraordinary
[*] struth = to express surprise (or dismay... it's surprise in our case)
[*] chockers = full of
[*] fair shake of the sauce bottle = give something a try / a chance
[/list]

notes.title: TY2 Build v1.09 (r3821) Has Been Released (Misc bug fix build)
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've released a new patch for TY2, which is a miscellaneous bug fix build.
Changes in this version are as per the below.

If there are any problems, please let us know.

Cheers
Linds

[b]Art[/b]
[list][*]Small fix for clamping of UI art in shops.[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list][*]Small tweaks to volumes of NPC lasers.
[*]Reduced the volume of the enemy drop ship engines slightly to help reduce audio clutter in the first level.[/list]

[b]Camera[/b]
[list][*]Fix for camera popping out of water when TY gets hurt or does a claim (picks up a collectable) underwater.
[*]Fix for a camera-getting-stuck issue.[/list]

[b]Controls[/b]
[list][*]Reset to Default no longer removes bindings for non-rebindable keys.
[*]Don't require the player to neutralise the input when changing to first person view camera before it will begin responding to input.
[*]Updated mouse aiming for rang throwing with fixes so that rangs don't throw into the ground when the camera is pointed at the ground (eg, normal third person gameplay).[/list]

[b]Crash Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fix issue with game props that could cause an endless loop issue and potential crash when a level is streaming.[/list]

[b]Massive Level Design Changes With Impacts Beyond the Realms of Space and Time[/b]
[list][*]Removed duplicate Naomi from Burramudgee.[/list]

[b]Save Games[/b]
[list][*]Fixed issue with loading an original save game (from a very early build when the game was in Early Access) not loading correctly with latest code.[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Wiggle controls (eg to shake off Frills attached to Bunyips) string updated to handle gamepad and keyboard controls.
[*]Bunyip Mortar control instructions now gives the correct controls for all languages. (Left/right stick were swapped, and no mention of Right Trigger to fire, in non-English languages).
[*]Fixed subtitles for non-English languages, that had broken button icons displayed
[*]Fixed the text that is displayed when the game cannot find a TY2 save game
[*]Fix for dunny not animating when playing all tracks or random tracks (ie, multiple races without returning to frontend between).
[*]On the rang hud, hide the "what direction is the gamepad stick being held" UI graphic element, when the sticks are not being used.[/list]

notes.title: TY2 Build r3499_v108 Released - Hardcore Mode! And, TY3 now in Early Access
notes.content:
Hi all,

A new build of TY2 (r3499_v108) has been released.
The major addition to this build is the new Hardcore Mode!

[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY2_Hardcore_banner.png[/img]

In Hardcore mode we've removed all bonus lives and respawning - you literally have <one> life to get through the game. If you do happen to lose a life; we helpfully reset your save game and restart your adventure.

We've added two new leaderboards (Hardcore Game Complete and Hardcore 100% Game Complete) and two new achievements (Completing the game in Hardcore and 100% Completing the Game in Hardcore) for your troubles!

We hope that this provides a little bit of replayability for you all (and maybe bragging rights!). And cheats are disabled in Hardcore mode :)

[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY2_Hardcore.gif[/img]

Additionally, we're happy to announce that TY3 has been released in to Early Access! As part of TY3's release, TY1 is currently on sale to celebrate; and if you own TY1 or TY2, you should receive an extra bonus discount for buying TY3 during this first week of Early Access - as we've increased the launch discount to 22% across the board!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/411980/TY_the_Tasmanian_Tiger_3/

Lastly, the following bug fixes are also in this new TY2 build:
[list][*]ART: Made grill texture in the Never Never doublesided, so it draws correctly from both directions.
[*]ART: clamped edge pixels of the mouse icons to stop icon corruption
[*]ART: Increased the number of maximum explosions that can render at once
[*]ART: Disabled timed-bonus Christmas skin costume
[*]ART: Re-added support for grass overlays
[*]CART RACING: Tweaked the difficulty of the AI to try to ensure people don't get stuck losing races, forever.
[*]CONTROLS: Fixed a force clamping bug where large movement forces can change your direction when only one axis is clamped.
[*]CONTROLS: Fixed support for sneaking when using KB&M (SHIFT key by default)
[*]GAMEPLAY: Fixed the "react to bunyip punches only" flag, so that [spoiler] the vehicles blocking the A-path in the first level can't be blown up by rangs, causing a non-progression issue[/spoiler]
[*]MISC: Crash fixes for various thread-safe issues
[*]MISC: Prevent mouse from changing button selection or clicking on buttons while rebinding an action to fix a crash.
[*]RANGS: Fixes to the doomerang controls
[*]UI: Moved some overlapping arrow buttons to lessen sound spamming when moving around them with the mouse.[/list]

Cheers
Linds

notes.title: TY2 Exiting Early Access Information + build r3040_v082 released to EXPERIMENTAL
notes.content:
Hey all,

We have some exciting news for you all!
Unless there is an unexpected problem, TY the Tasmanian Tiger 2: Bush Rescue, will release from Early Access early next week!

notes.title: TY2 Build r2920_v077 released on EXPERIMENTAL
notes.content:
Hi all,

A new build of TY2 is now available on EXPERIMENTAL.
There are a <lot> of changes in this build. Many of these are not noticable in terms of what is on screen - but there have been multiple optimizations and performance improvements, which will hopefully mean a much more stable framerate throughout the game!

Additionally, we have hopefully fixed the issue some players were having with the game rendering only in the top left corner of screen, in full screen mode.

Lastly, we've decided to remove the rang shops and replaced them with a bunch of lootboxes. Every kart race you race you've got a chance to earn a lootbox if you beat your best time, or you can purchase the lootboxes for the low, low price of $1.99USD each!
;)
(as this is the internet I will now make sure it's clear that the above is a joke, we have not removed the rang shops, there are no lootboxes to purchase as microtransactions).

Please check out the changes below, and let us know any problems.
At this stage our intention is to finalize the last few audio updates we have planned, update the language translations, then we will be looking to exit Early Access. Once these plans have been finalized, we'll make sure we do a post to let everybody know the timing, what's happening with the price post Early Access, etc (same as we did with TY1).

Almost there!

Cheers
Linds



[h1]AUDIO[/h1]
[list][*]Updated [spoiler]Cass' meteor attack sounds[/spoiler]
[*]Volume tweaks to various sounds across the game
[*]Updates to flame trap sounds
[*]Updates to ninja billie sounds - throwing stars now play looping sound while in the air
[*]Play SharkAlert sound when shark alerts. (25% chance for silence).
[*]Audio now pauses when the game loses focus
[*]Removed audio log spamming.[/list]


[h1]ART[/h1]
[list][*]Updated all the rang trails to be less 8-bit.
[*]Added location names to the whole game
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY2_LocationNames.gif[/img]
[*]Fix for some minimaps that didn't have the correct background color
[*]Texture upres for the kelp grass
[*]New opal bags[/list]

[h1]CAMERA[/h1]
[list][*]Push in the camera fade closer... so TY is less likely to alpha out[/list]

[h1]CRASHES[/h1]
[list][*]Fix for grass threading crash[/list]

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
[list][*]Enemies can now attack the Helicopter/sub again.
[*]PocketFluffy now makes a splash (visual and sound) when hitting the water during a "flinch"[/list]

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]
[list][*]Fix for Burramudgee shop objective markers not appearing when running in to town from Bush Rescue
[*]Fix grass issue in helicopter minigames - caused by using the same material on 2 different grass types.
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY2_ChopperGrass.gif[/img]
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY2_SubCoral.gif[/img]
[*]Improvements to the rendering of the shop prop neon signs
[*]Fixes to the water in the first custcene of the game
[*]Water reflections now handle view zoom - used by cutscenes and probably if you were looking through a zoom rang at water.
[*]Fixes to static batching so that prop groups that need to enable/disable by mission completion work correctly
[*]Fix dpi awareness - this will <hopefully> fix the issue people are having with the game only displaying in the top left corner, in certain set ups
[*]Fix window displaying twice during msaa creation
[*]Fix for grass types that had >1 grass models spawn from the same terrain triangle.
[*]Fix rendering so it doesn't static render props that need to be individually modified
[*]Removed subdivide from data conversion to the archive. This is always slower on modern hardware because of all the extra state changes drawing more subobjects.
[*]Updated opal bag rendering for speed improvements
[*]Fixes for lighting/visibility issues related to omnilight and shockwave effects[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]Removed unused option from CameraOptionsScreen - This option was moved into the RaceOptionsScreen that appears when starting a race.
[*]Fix for bug where the sound effect that plays when changing the volumes would play once when entering the sound options screen.
[*]Fixes to the minimap - fills the whole area now and the map is calibrated correctly for Burramudgee.
[*]Fixed bug where switching away from zoomerang while zoomed in, using the rang select wheel, would stay zoomed in.
[*]Switch to modern terminology "Left Stick" and "Right Stick" for controllers
[*]Fix for minimap North to display correctly in small mode
[*]Fixed Swedish credits not being updated last round of changes[/list]

We've found and fixed an issue that was causing some peoples' opal counts to get reset to 0 on loading a save game.

Cheers
Linds

notes.title: TY2 build r2278_v044 now available on EXPERIMENTAL
notes.content:
Hi all,

A new build is up on the EXPERIMENTAL branch.
There are a LOT of new changes in this build, but there are two of particular significance that we'd love to get your feedback on.

[h1]CART RACING[/h1]
Basically, we've touched a LOT of things with the cart racing.
[list][*]The default controller controls are now right trigger to accelerate, left trigger to brake, A to jump/powerslide and X to fire weapons (and similar for the fourbie)
[*]Cart handling (turning), powerslide, boost out of powerslide, jump height, acceleration and max velocity have all been tuned
[*]Cart camera positions and FOV have been tweaked
[*]We've added in the option to do split screen vertically as well as horizontally (currently in the camera options screen)
[*]Cart camera smoothing for vertical "bumps" so it doesn't jitter all over the place[/list]
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY-Race-update-June.png[/img]
The long and short of this is that the carts handle a LOT differently, and we think a lot better.
The "downside" to this is that part of us making things feel better has resulted in the overall speed being somewhat reduced - so people will more than likely not be able to beat their previous best time, or get top of the leaderboard, compared to the old code.
The plan is to get peoples' feedback on all these changes, and make adjustments.
Then, once adjustments are made we will be resetting the leaderboards for the carts, as well as resetting peoples' best times.
Feedback very much appreciated!

[h1]BOSS FIGHT CHANGES[/h1]
In addition to making the boss fights replayable, we've made some changes to [spoiler]BUSTER the Nanobot[/spoiler] boss fight.
We don't want to go in to too much detail here (that's spoil it!) but in short:
[spoiler][list][*]Attack ranges reduced to make him attack more
[*]Pauses between attacks removed to make it flow better
[*]Added some extra "boom" to some of the attacks ;) [/list][/spoiler]
Feedback would be awesome!

If <anybody> sees anything untoward with the save games (wrong percentages, not loading the old data, not tracking collectables properly, etc) please let us know ASAP!

We're releasing this build to experimental with a few less things implemented that we wanted to - there's been some delays due to a few bugs that popped up - so the new shop UI is not in this build (though other shop graphical improvements are).

Changes in this build as follows:

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list][*]CONTROLS: Mouse boomerang aiming now works like it does in TY1 on Steam (throws at the view direction)
[*]GRAPHICS: Added shadow normal support to improve shadow quality.[*]MAPS: Implement "won race" icon (trophy) on the maps.
[*]MAPS: Added star at Sgt Bluey's location in town, for the [spoiler]hidden frill mission[/spoiler]
[*]SAVES: New save system that alows us to add new save data, moving forward.
[*]SHOPS: Added initial lighting, shadows and SSAO to the shops.
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY%202%20store.jpg[/img]
[*]SHOPS: Added some VO that didn't get implemented in the original release. Have fun finding out what/where!
[*]UI: Boomerang HUD is now toggled on and off, instead of having to hold down the "action" button (Y button on X360 controller, R key (default binding) on keyboard and mouse).
[*]UI: You can now select <all> boomerangs from the Boomerang HUD, even after you upgrade them.[/list]

[h1]CONTENT UPDATES[/h1]
[list][*]ART: Updated the texture for the sheoak tree
[*]AUDIO: Updated whoosh sound for main menu logo sequence
[*]LEVELS: Changed how Sly's Shack art is loaded when you're driving around; so you can see it from a distance
[*]LEVELS: Merged half of the different level streaming packags together, for when you're driving around. Fixes a variety of different popping issues, etc.
[*]LEVELS: Added in "Big Croc" prop to the Southern Rivers, that didn't make the original release.
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY%202%20Barry.jpg[/img]
[*]LEVELS: Big props (prawn, pie, pineapple, croc) are bigger; and you can see them from further away.
[*]LEVELS: added warp flower to near Sly's Shack - once you've made it to the top once (from this build onwards), it will appear and let you avoid having to do the jump puzzle each time you want to buy a rang.

[*]LEVELS: Added some additional props around Sly's Shack
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY%202%20Sly%20shack.jpg[/img]
[*]LEVELS: Removed low poly houses from town, that we don't need anymore as the high-res ones are always loaded.
[*]LEVELS: Added some additional props around the entrance to Burramudgee from the Southern Rivers[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES and MISC[/h1]
[list][*]AUDIO: Rework of the audio acoustic settings system, to data drive it. Some tweaks to the various settings for the reverb etc while in caves.
[*]AUDIO: Fix for aquarang sounds that occasionally stopped it from playing a sound.
[*]AUDIO: Fixes to acoustic (reverb) support so that the reverb doesn't sometimes cut out, mid sound.
[*]GRAPHICS: Fixes to draw distance calculations that caused the settings to lag by one option.
[*]GRAPHICS: Fixed issue with shadow interpolation causing "forever shimmering" shadows.
[*]GRAPHICS: Fixes to grass system, so grass spawning on props (like the mossy logs) works again.
[*]GRAPHICS: Fixes for the visibility of the invisicrates and invisiplatforms (and them not being included in the shadow map).
[*]GRAPHICS: Fix for wave height in Sheep Dip
[*]KART RACING: Fixes to the chance for AI racers to take the shortcuts. Larger chance to take a shortcut, the further behind you they are, and reduced chance to do it, if they are close to you.
[*]KART RACING: Simplified the rubberbanding code and made some changes so that their catch-up is less aggressive, depending on the situation.
[*]LEADERBOARDS: Don't post a race result to the leaderboard unless it's better than the default time (10 mins).
[*]LEADERBOARDS: Display Race times display as m:ss.cc; game completion times display as d:hh:mm:ss
[*]MISC: Added some logging to an achievement that isn't unlocking for some users.
[*]MEMORY: Fixes for a variety of memory leaks.
[*]PERFORMANCE: Fixes for load-hitches as new data streams in.
[*]UI: Removed the word "Loading" from the loading screen (TY logo with animated rings). Linds personal note - Have hated that being there since the original release, where it had to be there for TRC requirements.[/list]


[h1]WHAT'S NEXT[/h1]
At the moment, the plans for next work include:
[list][*]LEVELS: Continued level prop placement improvements.
[*]PERFORMANCE: Rewrite of the grass system to improve performance.
[*]UI: New shop UI art implementation.[/list]

As per normal; please let us know any problems, and enjoy!

Linds

notes.title: What's Coming Next?!
notes.content:
Hey all,

So - things have been a little slow the last month, as there have been a <bunch> of holidays here in Australia around Easter. But we are still making good progress on some new features, so we thought we'd share some of these with you.

Some of the things we've been working on aren't very "visual" - but others should have a pretty large graphical impact on the game!

We're looking to do a new build to "experimental", once we implement the new Shop UI (which is basically the next task).

Some of the upcoming changes:
[list][*]SHOPS: Implemented the shadow, SSAO etc system in to the shops. More work to come here, with some lighting etc - but that needs to wait until after the new UI is implemented (note - textures for the shops haven't been upres'd yet).

[*]SHOPS: Implemented some more VO that was all set up in the original game, but never triggered (will leave it to you guys to find out what this is!).
[*]BOOMERANGS: 1st pass implementation of being able to select the Tier 1 boomerangs, even after you buy the Tier 2 versions. Still need to do some polish on this for the controls before we add it to a build. Also - we've changed it so the selection overlay toggles on/off; instead of you having to hold a button
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/Rang%20Select.jpg[/img]
[*]SAVE GAMES: Lots of "under the hood" work to allow us to add more things to the save games, so that we can implement some little bits and pieces; like a warp flower to get to the top of Sly's Spire, once you've done the jump puzzle once!
[*]MAPS: Added a trophy icon (that was in the original game but not hooked up due to time) to show which races have been won
[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/map%20icons.jpg[/img][/list]

We're probably looking at mid-May, for the next experimental build, depending on how well the implementation control improvements for the boomerang selection and the shop UI updates goes.

This isn't a complete list of what we've done... just a few titbits to whet the appetite! :)

Any questions, let us know!

Cheers
Linds

notes.title: TY2 Builds - Information for Moving Forward
notes.content:
Hi all,

So, this game is kind of HUGE! :)

We've been thinking hard on how we want to handle updates that are up and coming, with us making changes to parts of the game that are so intricate and widespread that making any changes really does require a full retest to check out how it's used throughout the game (for example - the camera).

We've decided that we're going to change our build updates so that:
[list][*]We have an additional "Experimental" Beta available for you. This will have the latest and greatest stuff, as we do it, for people to comment on; help out with issues and what not. But, people do this understanding that it may not be stable, may have unintended new issues (recent example - the helicopter camera breaking).
This branch is active and available now (though the build is currently the same as the standard build). To access it - right click on the game in your library, select properties, select the "BETAS" tab and select "experimental" from the drop down menu. You may need to reload Steam for it to be available. A picture of this is at the bottom of the post.

[*]The standard branch on Steam will get new bulids less frequently. When we do one of these builds, they're going to go through a much more rigourous test process than the Experimental branch builds.[/list]

We're not quite certain of what the build schedule for the standard branch will be at this point - it really will depend on how the Experimental branch goes, and weighing up the time taken to test things vs implement more fixes and additions - so we'll see how we go and ease in to it.

What this does mean is that we're more likely to push updates for large-ticket items quickly, for people to check out and give us feedback on. For example:
[list][*]Initial Spanish, Italian, Swedish and Danish support
[*]Fixes for the button icon replacement throughout the UI
[*]Changes to the level streaming so it's not as annoying running through/around town[/list]

Thanks to everybody who's help out with suggestion and bug information so far. Hopefully this will help us continue to make good progress, as well as make sure that the people who don't want to be on the bleeding edge maintain a stable experience (stable for Early Access at least!).

Happy to hear peoples' feedback.

Cheers
Linds

[img]http://www.kromestudios.com/share/TY2_beta.png[/img]

notes.title: TY2 Build r1882_v023 Has Been Released
notes.content:
Hi all,

A new build of TY2 is available. The focus continues to be on improving the areas that you guys are mentioning as being things that most distract from playing the game through, as well as critical (crash) issues. Changes in this build:

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list][*]ART: Activate icon on signs etc changed to match to TY1 (! icon).
[*]ART: Changes to beach water of the overworld (Souther Rivers) to flatten water, and allow ripples.
[*]AUDIO: Fixes for music ducking erroneously muting the audio when going in/out of pause menu, pausing during a cutscene, etc. Hopefully this resolves the majority of this problem.
[*]CAMERA: Fix for everything going crazy when you try to lasharang rings, and you're running at low framerate.
[*]CAMERA: Fix for an instance of the camera position occasionally getting stuck in a position.
[*]CONTROLS: Changes to controller deadzone calculations to try to aid people having issues with "full speed run" (when holding the left stick to the maximum extent).
[*]CONTROLS: Fix so that you control the aim of the 1st person camera with the mouse, if using keyboard and mouse, and not WASD (default binding) - more control fixes are still to come for 1st person view, but this should be a good start for people.
[*]CONTROLS: mouse control of the mortar bunyip (for aiming) and W/S (for zooming) is now implemented.
[*]CONTROLS: controller controls of first person now work more like what we've done for TY1 (both sticks can aim; R trigger can also throw rangs).
[*]CONTROLS: "JUMP WITH TY" is now enabled by default when you start a new game (unless you disable it on the main menu then start a game, etc).
[*]CRASH FIX: Fix for crash if you hit F1 in the game.
[*]RACES: Some rework of the position calculations that assigns race positions after people have crossed the endpoint - hopefully fixing any "not in the correct place for how well you actually did" issues.
[*]UI: Updated controller binding information images to X360 images.
[*]UI: Copyright screen displayed for less time on boot.[/list]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list][*]GAMEPLAY: Made the mortar bunyip fight in the first level easier (dropships have less hitpoints).
[*]UI: You can now skip videos (eg Krome logo) with common buttons on any device (eg left mouse click).[/list]

[h1]WHAT'S NEXT[/h1] (pending us not needing to jump on to more critical issues)
[list][*]UI: Display appropriate icons in the cutscenes, UI, popups etc depending on your current control device.
[*]CAMERA: Further fixes to the camera, to reimplement some of the changes we did on TY1 for Steam, into the new camera system in TY2.
[*]CAMERA: Implement full 1st person and 3rd person invert options as per TY1.
[*]AUDIO: Implement separate subbus for VO.
[*]LOCALIZATION: Implement Spanish, Italian, Swedish (text only) and Danish (text only).[/list]

Any issues, please let us know. Keep in mind we're in Australia so we're knocking off from work in a few hours, but we'll be back at it in the morning :)

Cheers!
Linds
